gitCommit.subject: fix(canvas): add i18n support to FrameExportPanel sidebar (#1396)
gitCommit.body:
fix(canvas): add i18n support to FrameExportPanel sidebar (#1396)

The frame export panel was displaying hardcoded English strings regardless
of the user's locale setting. Added exportPanel translation keys to all 4
locale files (en, ja, zh-TW, zh-CN) and updated FrameExportPanel.tsx to
use useTranslations('Canvas') for all 10 user-facing strings.
